## Claim amendment · 2026-11-17T18:50Z

Seat 3 rules on area o3-B's sizing (live on 8e498475c3, zh-CN):

- **Part 1 (mapping label untranslated): route A, label only.** A new `mappings` translation group carrying `mappings.<name>.label`, `translateMapping` registered in `METADATA_DOCUMENT_TRANSLATORS`, and the packaged-base guard, following the books precedent (031d97a00f). `description` is out: `MappingSchema` has no description, so a bundle key would translate nothing; adding one is a separate widening. Routes B (client-side messages key) and C (inline translations on `MappingSchema`) are rejected as an undeclared dialect and a retired dialect.
- **Declarations amended:** `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added` (new authorable bundle key), spec level per AGENTS.md checklist. Seat L2 at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER after L1-a.
- **Split accepted:** the UI half (mapping summary shows served labels; Back + reload under a selected mapping no longer auto-maps the preview) ships first as its own PR, `Part of #34939`, `Clause-②: no`, through L1-a. Part 1 follows under `Fixes #34939`.
- Surface grows to the spec translation schema and generated artifacts, rest/cli/lint translator registration, ui reader, docs and showcase as the measured file list names; o3-B posts that list before coding part 1.
